text.tspan: Source: local RB at1280×631 CSS px, devicePixelRatio1.5. Screen examples use DEMO serials and illustrative workflow icons, not assertions about live repair status.
Home warehouse selection with session persistence; serial lookup, Scan, Find unit and Register unit; Filter; direct selected-label printing; serial/model/site/Fz/Simpro/Var job; row navigation and
The observed incoming queue uses180px before search. Use a44–52px collapsible summary with count, retain all incoming cards on expansion and their existing Review action. This is a layout
Use the space for actual data
The observed checkbox column is about101px. Proposed widths total1216px:40/208/104/240/328/104/104/88. Values remain13px; labels12px. Site and Fz wrap to two lines, full values remain
One main status plus optional warning/return marker. Tooltip and accessible name are mandatory. Assessment uses stethoscope; QC blue thumbs-up; Repaired green check; WEEE red ordinary bin.
Clicking a checkbox does not open the repair. Selected count is visible. Print is disabled at0 and active after selection; no unnecessary bulk-action modal. Preview does not send a print job.
Current Type choices are stretched far apart beside the long Status list. Align short lists at the top; keep Status/Type/Engineer groups and all current status options. Use TBC instead of technical
UNASSESSED. Sticky header/footer and scrollable body in the real dialog; Escape/Cancel do not apply filters.
Natural-language/voice search is future work and is not shown as working. No new pagination, sorting defaults or company access changes are introduced. Oldest registered remains the default;
Real filter options are retained for compatibility. Engineer labels here illustrate the current visible names; implementation must reuse server-authorised choices without merging accounts. These
editable frames are a design proposal; live status derivation and responsive acceptance require implementation tests.
